at 2026-08-10T14:00:00Z

mkdir project-show
cd project-show
exec card init --prefix root- --no-board
exec card project create Secondary --prefix secondary-

# A project with no boards can be inspected by stable ID without selecting a board.
exec card --json project show project_11111111111111111111
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/empty.json
! exists .git/cardamom-board

# Name selection returns project-scoped configuration and deterministically
# ordered board summaries without adding a project filter to board list.
exec card board create --project project_11111111111111111111 Zulu
exec card board create --project project_11111111111111111111 Alpha
exec card board create --project project_11111111111111111111 Alpha
exec card --json project show Secondary
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/populated.json
exec card project show Secondary
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/populated.txt
! exists .git/cardamom-board

# Duplicate exact names retain the existing selector ambiguity contract.
exec card project create Secondary --prefix duplicate-
! exec card project show Secondary
! stdout .
stderr 'project "Secondary" is ambiguous; use an ID'
